direct_visual_findings.principle: A photo sequence, authentic poster, object evidence and compact dialogue each serve a different learner action. Integrated sketches and photographic cutouts give specificity. Clear instruction verbs and compact category labels permit variety without losing navigation.
direct_visual_findings.adaptation: Clearer learner actions; deliberate illustrated evidence for connected actions/objects; real contextual photography; lighter shared navigation. No source words/art copied.

direct_visual_findings.principle: A tangible lesson objective, language in context, small accuracy check and genuine speaking payoff make the page usable. A compact clarification panel supports the source rather than dominating it.
direct_visual_findings.adaptation: Replace topic-only objectives with useful outcomes, lighten focus frames, strengthen partner checks and real decisions. The source is higher-level; its language is not imported into A1.

direct_visual_findings.principle: Occupation/routine illustration, real faces, an ID-card artifact, environmental photos and genre-specific articles coexist. Source lettering follows its artifact rather than a universal accent-font headline. Reviews mix retrieval with a visual anchor.
direct_visual_findings.adaptation: Choose a medium by teaching role; retain useful backgrounds; varied source architecture; balanced review columns and fresh final transfer.

direct_visual_findings.principle: Forum/post/document treatments, thematic photo compositions, compact source panels and restrained concept explanations give editorial richness. Advanced linguistic density is not a model for beginner copy.
direct_visual_findings.adaptation: Keep source-specific structures, useful photos and meaningful color relationships while protecting beginner reading size and response room.
